description: Land Acquisition - Ranna, Thangalla D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire land for a public purpose (bridge construction), provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels (lot numbers, names, extents, boundaries), and outlines the process for interested parties to claim compensation. The content is exclusively focused on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
